title: Tesla sustains its EV sales momentum despite US troubles | TechCrunch
summary: Despite the rebound in overall momentum, sales have become something of a taboo subject for Tesla CEO Elon Musk, who is increasingly focused on the company’s other efforts. The company aims to make roughly 50,000 Tesla Semi vehicles per year.
